'''Starfruit creme liqueur''' was a [[Liqueur/Legends|drink]] served as a [[Mouth/Legends|palate]] cleanser on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] at the launch of the [[Hovertrain/Legends|repulsortrain]] ''[[Gem of Alderaan]]''<ref name="Gem of Alderaan" /> circa [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]].<ref name="Date">"[[Echoes of the Jedi]]," the fourth installment of the ''[[Dawn of Defiance]]'' campaign, states that the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vhiin Thorla]] traveled to the [[Almas Academy]] two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was issued, an event that is dated to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. "[[The Gem of Alderaan]]" is said to take place at least six [[Standard month/Legends|months]] afterward, placing the launch at some point around [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]].</ref> The drink was made by blending [[Ithorian starfruit]] into a creme liqueur. It was [[Diet/Legends|potable]] by a variety of [[Species/Legends|species]], including [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]], [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]], [[Cerean/Legends|Cereans]], [[Duros/Legends|Duros]], [[Herglic/Legends|Herglics]], [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]], [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]], [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], and [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltrons]].<ref name="Gem of Alderaan" />

==Behind the scenes==
Starfruit creme liqueur was mentioned in "[[The Gem of Alderaan]]," the eighth adventure in [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Dawn of Defiance]]'' campaign for their ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''. The installment was written by [[Gary M. Sarli]] and released in [[2009]].<ref name="Gem of Alderaan" />
